    1. tryIt()

Schnittstelle Triable<A>

Typparameter:
A - the expected result type on success
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Attempt
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Triable<A>

Represents a computation that either successfully produces a value of type A or fails with an Exception.

The Triable interface acts as a functional abstraction for lazy or repeatable computations whose outcome is uncertain. It can be used to model fault-tolerant or exception-prone processes – similar to a Supplier, but with explicit error handling via XorValue.

Contract:

  • This method must never throw; failures are returned as Left(Exception).
  • The returned XorValue must not be null.
  • Implementations should document whether evaluation is lazy/eager and whether calls are idempotent.

    • tryIt

      @NonNull XorValue<Exception, A> tryIt()

      Executes the computation and returns either the exception (failure) or the computed result (success). This method must not throw.

      Gibt zurück:
      a non-null XorValue containing either Left(Exception) on failure or Right(A) on success
